summary: Architectural Precision direct from Italy, available in 4 variations and a rich palette of matte and gloss colours, the new Shard X Bench basins are a bold wash area centrepiece, even in small bathrooms.
title: New Shard X Basins - Beautiful Geometry
bodyHtml:
The New Shard X 50 in Gloss Petrol - 500 x 350 x 140 mm

Pure Geometry, Refined in Italy

An exploration of purity in line and proportion, the new Shard X Series brings a bold architectural presence to the bathroom.

Balancing expressive minimalism with confident strength, Shard X turns geometry into a beautiful focal point—crisp, elemental, and contemporary.


Perfect for Powder Rooms - Shard X 35 Bench - 350 x 350 x 140 mm

Scaled for Versatility

Now available with shorter projections, Shard X delivers its distinct presence to even the most space-conscious environments. Its reduced footprint makes it an ideal solution for powder rooms and smaller bathrooms, without compromising on the clarity or strength of its design language.


Shard X 60 Bench in Matte Black - 600 x 350 x 140 mm

Italian Craftsmanship in Full Colour

Crafted and hand-finished in Italy by our longstanding partners, Olympia Ceramica, the new Shard X Series offers a refined palette of matte and gloss finishes — each selected to elevate a broad range of interior directions.

The result is a basin that feels both considered and bold — a refined expression of material and form.


New Shard X 50 Bench in Gloss Pink - 500 x 350 x 140 mm


New Shard X 70 Bench - 700 x 350 x 140 mm
